recipes.name: Basic Versagel Lip Gloss
recipes.description: Simple lip gloss base using Versagel. High shine, non-sticky finish. Add flavor oil or fragrance and mica for color.
recipes.notes: Versagel is thick — warm gently between palms or in a warm water bath to make it workable. Castor oil adds extra gloss and slip. Mica can be stirred in for tinted gloss.

recipes.name: 4-Ingredient Whipped Shea Butter
recipes.description: The simplest whipped body butter — just shea, a liquid oil, vitamin E, and fragrance. Fluffy, melt-on-skin texture.
recipes.notes: No heat needed if shea is already soft/fluffy. Sub sunflower with any light liquid oil (apricot kernel, sweet almond, hemp seed).

recipes.name: 5-Ingredient Whipped Shea Butter
recipes.description: Adds arrowroot or corn starch to reduce the greasy feel — silkier finish on skin.
recipes.notes: Corn starch works as a 1:1 sub for arrowroot. Whip shea first, add oil gradually, fold in starch last.

recipes.name: 9-Ingredient Whipped Shea Butter
recipes.description: More complex whipped butter with multiple oils for a richer skin feel.
recipes.notes: Coconut oil may require brief melt in warm weather. Mango butter adds firmness and a smoother melt point.

recipes.name: DIY Aloe Vera Gel
recipes.description: Simple water-based gel. Lightweight, soothing, good for oily or sensitive skin. Needs preservative.
recipes.notes: Xanthan gum is a thickener not in current inventory — recipe still works without it but will be thinner. Preservative required since water-based.

recipes.name: Dry Summer Body Oil
recipes.description: Lightweight, non-greasy body oil blend. Absorbs fast. No water phase = no preservative needed.
recipes.notes: Sub MCT with fractionated coconut or apricot kernel. Rosehip is not in inventory but optional — sub with hemp seed.

recipes.name: Hemp & Apricot Body Oil
recipes.description: Custom blend using on-hand oils. Hemp seed adds anti-inflammatory properties, apricot kernel absorbs quickly.
recipes.notes: All ingredients in inventory. Castor adds slip and gloss. Adjust ratios to preference.

recipes.name: Easy Emulsified Body Butter
recipes.description: Lotion-like body butter with water phase for a lighter feel. Needs emulsifier and preservative.
recipes.notes: BTMS-50 (conditioning emulsifier) not in inventory. Sub with Polysorbate-20 at slightly higher % but texture will differ.

recipes.name: Shimmery Body Oil Spray
recipes.description: Spray-on body oil with shimmer. Needs heat to dissolve mica into oil phase.
recipes.notes: Polysorbate-20 in inventory. Sub fractionated coconut with apricot kernel or hemp seed.

recipes.name: Lighter Whipped Shea Butter
recipes.description: Partially melted shea blended with lighter oils for a less waxy finish.
recipes.notes: Heat to melt coconut oil fully, then cool to just-solidified before whipping.

recipes.name: Hemp Seed Body Lotion
recipes.description: Water-based lotion using hemp seed and apricot kernel. Needs emulsifier — Polysorbate-20 can work at higher %.
recipes.notes: Polysorbate-20 is a light emulsifier — may need higher % for stable emulsion. Proper emulsifiers (BTMS-50, Emulsifying Wax) give better texture.

recipes.name: Witch Hazel Aloe Toner
recipes.description: Simple face/body toner. Witch hazel tones and tightens, aloe soothes, glycerin hydrates.
recipes.notes: All ingredients in inventory. Polysorbate-20 solubilizes any added fragrance or essential oil. Preservative required — water-based product.

recipes.name: Raspberry Mint No-Melt Summer Body Butter
recipes.description: Stable in heat — uses higher-melting waxes to prevent summer melt.
recipes.notes: Candelilla wax not in inventory. Beeswax could sub but changes texture significantly.

recipes.name: Happy Hemp Hand Cream
recipes.description: Rich hand cream with hemp seed oil. Water phase requires heat and proper emulsification.
recipes.notes: BTMS-50 not in inventory. Without it, emulsion won't hold properly. Note for shopping list.

recipes.name: Autumn Spice Whipped Body Butter
recipes.description: Seasonal scented whipped butter. Melt-and-whip method.
recipes.notes: Sweet almond oil not in inventory. Sub with apricot kernel (similar profile) or hemp seed.

recipes.name: Jojoba Mint Natural Foot Cream
recipes.description: Rich, velvety emulsified foot cream with jojoba and shea. Peppermint essential oil provides a cooling tingle.
recipes.notes: Cetyl alcohol thickens and gives a silky feel. Sodium lactate is a natural humectant that also adjusts pH. Requires a pH in the 4.8–5 range for preservative efficacy. Store in a wide-mouthed jar.

recipes.name: Sugar Plum Fairy Shimmer Oil
recipes.description: Luxurious shimmer body/face/hair oil with plum kernel and apricot kernel. Iridescent mica creates a fairy-like glow.
recipes.notes: Original uses Crystal Clear Wax (0.5%) to suspend mica — can omit but mica will settle. Sub plum kernel with apricot kernel. No water = no preservative needed.

recipes.name: Soothing Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Serum
recipes.description: Lightweight water-based serum with hyaluronic acid for deep hydration. No heating required — just mix and let hydrate.
recipes.notes: Hyaluronic acid here is used as a 1% pre-dissolved solution (30% of batch = 30g of that solution). Let xanthan gum hydrate for at least 20 minutes before use. Target pH 5–5.5. Preservative required.

recipes.name: Super Nourishing Hair Balm
recipes.description: Anhydrous balm for dry hair ends. Beeswax provides hold, shea and jojoba add deep conditioning.
recipes.notes: Original includes cocoa butter (15%), camellia seed oil (10%), walnut oil (6%) not in inventory. Sub with more shea and coconut. Use sparingly on hair ends only — a little goes a long way.

recipes.name: Super Simple Lightweight Hair Conditioner
recipes.description: Beginner-friendly rinse-out conditioner. Just 4–6 ingredients, silky slip, and a clean rinse.
recipes.notes: BTMS-50 is the key conditioning emulsifier (not in inventory). Sub MCT with fractionated coconut. Heat water and BTMS-50 together at 75–80°C; blend; cool to 40°C before adding preservative.

recipes.name: Coco-Cocoa Whipped Body Butter
recipes.description: Decadent whipped butter made from just cocoa butter and coconut oil — naturally scented chocolate-coconut.
recipes.notes: Melt both together, cool to near-solid, then whip with electric beaters. Chill slightly between whipping rounds. Cocoa butter not in inventory — it is the dominant ingredient. Optional: add a few drops of essential oil.

recipes.name: Tropical Shimmer Body Butter
recipes.description: Firm anhydrous body butter with a natural chocolate-coconut aroma. Mica optional for a subtle shimmer.
recipes.notes: Melt together, stir continuously as it cools to custard-like texture, then pour into tin. A little goes a long way — firm texture prevents over-application. Cocoa butter not in inventory.

recipes.name: Perfect Massage Oil
recipes.description: Simple anhydrous massage oil — liquid at room temperature, glides smoothly on skin.
recipes.notes: Coconut oil melts at 24°C — it may need gentle warming to blend. Sub apricot kernel with sweet almond. Cinnamon bark essential oil used at only 0.05% (safety limit). Warm in hands before applying.

recipes.name: Argan Oil Facial Serum
recipes.description: 100% oil-based facial serum — just argan oil and a few drops of essential oils. No preservative needed.
recipes.notes: Argan oil is not in inventory. Use 4–5 drops on face once or twice daily. Store in dark amber glass bottle. Shelf life ~1 year. For sensitive skin, start without essential oils.

recipes.name: Argan Serum for Mature Skin
recipes.description: Anti-aging facial serum with argan oil and carrot seed essential oil — rich in antioxidants.
recipes.notes: Essential oils: carrot seed + chamomile. Argan not in inventory — sub with rosehip (excellent for mature skin). Use dark glass dropper bottle. Start with 3 drops carrot seed EO; it has a strong earthy smell.

recipes.name: Rosehip & Healing Facial Serum
recipes.description: Two-oil healing serum for scars and hyperpigmentation. Rosehip regenerates, tamanu heals.
recipes.notes: Original uses tamanu oil (not in inventory) — sub with jojoba for a gentle, non-comedogenic version. Add 2 drops frankincense + 1 drop helichrysum EO per 15mL for enhanced healing. No heat, no preservative needed.

recipes.name: Intensely Moisturizing Shea Butter Lip Balm
recipes.description: Rich, healing lip balm with shea butter and beeswax. Melts perfectly at body temperature.
recipes.notes: Olive oil and avocado oil not in inventory — sub with apricot kernel or sweet almond. Melt together in a double boiler, add EO off heat, pour immediately into tubes. Yields 4–5 tubes.

recipes.name: Peppermint Cocoa Lip Balm
recipes.description: Classic lip balm with a peppermint tingle. Cocoa butter provides natural chocolate fragrance.
recipes.notes: Sweet almond and cocoa butter not in inventory — sub almond with apricot kernel. Essential oil is peppermint (20 drops per ~49g batch). Yields ~10–11 tubes. Melt together, add EO off heat.

recipes.name: Coconut & Beeswax Body Butter
recipes.description: Simple tropical body butter — just coconut oil and beeswax. Solid at room temperature, melts on contact.
recipes.notes: Melt all together, pour into shallow tin. Original uses kukuinut and baobab oil — sub with jojoba and apricot kernel. No preservative needed (anhydrous). Coconut provides a natural tropical scent.

recipes.name: Shimmery Body Oil with Mica
recipes.description: Fast-absorbing shimmer oil using grapeseed and a small amount of butter. Mica settles unless shaken.
recipes.notes: Grapeseed not in inventory — sub with apricot kernel or sunflower. Melt butter into oil, cool, add mica in bottle. Shake before each use. Any fine mica color works.

recipes.name: Oat Milk Dream Cream
recipes.description: Gentle lotion with colloidal oatmeal and olive oil. Soothing for dry or sensitive skin.
recipes.notes: Olive oil and cocoa butter not in inventory — sub olive with sunflower or apricot kernel, cocoa butter with mango butter. Colloidal oatmeal is soothing for eczema-prone skin.

recipes.name: Anti-Frizz Hair Mist
recipes.description: Lightweight spray that controls frizz without weighing hair down. Polysorbate-20 disperses oil in water.
recipes.notes: Original uses camellia oil — apricot kernel is a great sub. Polysorbate-20 is in inventory. Spray sparingly; too much = greasy. Preservative required (water-based).

recipes.name: Hydrating Body Mist
recipes.description: Aloe-based body spray with a touch of oil for post-shower hydration. Quick, no-rub moisture.
recipes.notes: All core ingredients in inventory. Sub grapeseed oil with apricot kernel. Shake before use if no Polysorbate-20 is added. Apply immediately after toweling off.

recipes.name: Vegan Hemp Body Butter
recipes.description: All-hemp seed oil body butter firmed with vegan waxes. Glassy green appearance, smooth texture.
recipes.notes: Hemp seed oil in inventory! Use double boiler — hemp has a low smoke point. Needs 3 days to cure before use. Original uses bayberry wax + candelilla wax; beeswax is a substitute (not fully vegan). Sub candelilla with more beeswax if needed.

recipes.name: Simple Sugar Body Scrub
recipes.description: Classic two-ingredient sugar scrub — oil and sugar. Exfoliates and moisturizes in one step.
recipes.notes: Use Polysorbate-20 (~10%) to make it rinse cleanly and reduce slip hazard. Coconut oil and apricot kernel in inventory. Keep dry — water contamination causes mold. Store outside shower.

recipes.name: Warming Coconut Massage Oil
recipes.description: Simple warming massage oil for sore muscles. Coconut provides slip, apricot kernel absorbs well.
recipes.notes: All ingredients in inventory. Castor oil adds extra slip. Warm in hands before applying. Use ginger or peppermint EO for warming/cooling effect.

recipes.name: Creamy Shea Exfoliating Scrub
recipes.description: Emulsified scrub that rinses clean and leaves skin soft. Lotion base with pumice or salt exfoliants.
recipes.notes: Original adds pumice (1 tbsp) and coarse salt (1 tsp) after emulsion forms. Essential oils (lavender + fir) add fragrance. Shea butter in inventory. Use corn starch instead of pumice if needed for gentler scrub.

recipes.name: Basic DIY Body Lotion
recipes.description: Old-school cold cream style lotion. Heavier and more occlusive than modern emulsifier-based lotions.
recipes.notes: This is a cold-cream style formula — greasy and occlusive. Good as a night cream. Cool both phases separately before combining. Grapeseed oil in original — subbed with apricot kernel.
